description: This Java class defines a custom datatype for Location objects in the OpenMRS project, providing serialization and deserialization logic based on UUIDs.

classes.name: LocationDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype class for OpenMRS locations, capable of deserializing location objects from UUID strings.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a UUID string into a Location object by retrieving it from the LocationService. Returns null if the input is blank or null.
